summary.headline: Judging War and Civic Impediments
summary.text: Chapter 27 explains how to judge whether war will occur and who will win through the significators of the king, the year, and the questioner, considering planetary aspects, strength, weakness, enmity, peace, houses, and revolutions. Chapter 28 begins with the impediment and subjugation of citizens by a planet under the rays, especially when angular in the revolution or afflicted by a malefic.
